save_isolation: Fresh SaveState injected before Main.ready; initial Main/Castle fixture then real card/hotspot/touch/hold/Back events. No personal save, forced phases/completion, patched callbacks or fabricated reward.

steps.title: Reach the Stuffie Playroom
steps.child_sees: Castle room doors and, after the relevant story gates, the Stuffie Playroom career pictures.
steps.gesture: Touch the Stuffie Playroom picture door.
steps.configured_instruction: Locked route text: “The castle jobs are locked until our cleaning adventure is done!” (generic hint audio).
steps.embodied_action_and_contact: Roshan must enter the room before its Doctor card can own the launch. This approach was not captured from a fresh save.
steps.before_action_after: Before: Castle route. Action: room-door selection. After: Stuffie Playroom; first usable card availability is unproven from a fresh save.
steps.next: Choose the Doctor picture in step 2.

steps.title: Choose Doctor Roshan
steps.child_sees: The left of the two career picture cards above the stuffies: Roshan in her doctor coat, with a stethoscope crest.
steps.gesture: Tap the Doctor picture at approximately 550,85 in this 1280×720 capture.
steps.configured_instruction: Entry config: “Stuffie Surgeon Roshan and the surgeon imp each have a plushy-care station. Find each ouch, check the X-ray and wrap every soft cast with care!”
steps.embodied_action_and_contact: The real picture-card callback suspends this room and starts act 5; this is actual touch input after fixture setup.
steps.before_action_after: Before: room/card. Action: tap. After: the clinic invitation.
steps.next: Follow the pulsing clinic object in step 3.

steps.title: Approach the lit clinic object
steps.child_sees: A blue pulsing ring around the stethoscope clinic at upper left. Roshan waits beside the painted walkway.
steps.gesture: Tap the lit stethoscope object; let Roshan reach it.
steps.configured_instruction: “Hold the bubbly basin to wash Doctor Roshan’s hands!” Key: op_doctor_wash_stage.
steps.embodied_action_and_contact: The production hotspot routes Roshan to the station before opening the wash surface. Arrival itself grants no wash progress.
steps.before_action_after: Before: invitation ring and closed task. Action: hotspot tap/approach. After: the basin activity appears.

steps.title: Start washing
steps.child_sees: The basin appears at the right; the fingertip cue sits over the wash surface.
steps.gesture: Keep one finger down over the basin, around 1040,384 in the shown canvas.
steps.configured_instruction: “Hold the bubbly basin to wash Doctor Roshan’s hands!” Key: op_doctor_wash_stage.
steps.embodied_action_and_contact: Roshan changes task pose at the left. The procedural hands are detached at the right: truthful hand/sink contact still fails.
steps.before_action_after: Before: ready basin. Action: sustained hold; water/bubbles and widget fill advance. After: partial wash, with no career star.
steps.next: Continue holding, or lift to pause as in step 6.

steps.title: Watch the wash in progress
steps.child_sees: Bubbles and the hand shapes accumulate in the basin while Doctor Roshan remains at the left.
steps.configured_instruction: Same WASH prompt; capture audio used Dummy, so exact spoken playback was not auditioned.
steps.embodied_action_and_contact: The saved native midpoint exposes the owner’s contact defect: Roshan’s own wrists/arms do not join the working hands; stream/palm/rim interaction is not accepted.
steps.before_action_after: Before: ready basin surface. Action: held work builds the visible wash. After: partially filled/bubbly state. This is not a separate authored rinse action.
steps.next: Release to pause or continue to earn this phase.

steps.title: Lift to pause, hold again to continue
steps.child_sees: The partial basin remains; the wash is not complete.
steps.gesture: Lift one finger. To resume, press and hold the basin again.
steps.configured_instruction: Same WASH instruction; no distinct configured pause line.
steps.embodied_action_and_contact: The current candidate keeps Roshan at her wash work point instead of applying the generic release hop. Contact artwork remains defective.
steps.before_action_after: Before: 1.384414 earned wash units. Action: release for 20 frames. After: unchanged in-run progress; resume adds earned hold time. This does not prove app-kill checkpoint persistence.
steps.next: Complete enough real hold to reach 3.6 wash units.

steps.title: See the finished wash
steps.child_sees: The completed wash picture and celebration are held before the next station is armed.
steps.gesture: Let the completion picture settle; a valid touch can advance the phase hold.
steps.configured_instruction: The next configured prompt will be FIND; this completed WASH alone earns no Doctor career star.
steps.embodied_action_and_contact: Roshan cheers. The actor-position repair is machine/capture verified only; connected scrubbing/rinsing, valve grip and runoff remain unresolved.
steps.before_action_after: Before: partial basin. Action: enough real sustained hold. After: accepted first-phase state; the real run reached 3.61489433333333 units.
steps.next: The starfish triage invitation appears in step 8.

steps.title: Go to the glowing patient station
steps.child_sees: A blue ring highlights the left starfish triage alcove. Roshan returns to the room approach point.
steps.gesture: Tap the lit starfish triage object and let Roshan arrive.
steps.configured_instruction: “Choose the plushy with the glowing ouch!” Key: op_doctor_find_stage.
steps.embodied_action_and_contact: The invitation itself is captured. The campaign exits before opening and completing FIND.
steps.before_action_after: Before: finished WASH. Action: normal phase advance restores the room. After: FIND invitation; patient choices are still closed.
steps.next: Open FIND, then follow the glowing patient in step 9.

steps.title: Choose the plushy with the glowing ouch
steps.child_sees: The configured lanes_doctor choice surface flashes the current target among three lanes. Exact rendered before/action/after screens are missing.
steps.gesture: Tap the glowing patient; the target shifts after each correct choice.
steps.configured_instruction: “Choose the plushy with the glowing ouch!” Key: op_doctor_find_stage.
steps.embodied_action_and_contact: The shared surface accepts patient-lane taps and plays Roshan’s task pose/bounce. Direct examining contact is not verified.
steps.before_action_after: Before: one highlighted choice. Action: correct choices add 1; wrong picks reflash the same answer. After: progress reaches 4 and the result holds.
steps.next: Approach the exam booth for X-RAY.

steps.title: Scan the two sore spots
steps.child_sees: The exam-booth task uses the scanner/device and a moving finger demo. Exact native task screen/contact is uncaptured.
steps.gesture: Drag across the plushy: follow the scanner to the first indicated spot, then the second.
steps.configured_instruction: “Slide the scanner over the plushy to find the sore spots!” Key: op_doctor_x_ray_stage.
steps.embodied_action_and_contact: Scanner motion follows one finger; travel of at least 3 surface pixels must cross the current target. Roshan/tool attachment is not visually proven.
steps.before_action_after: Before: 0 found. Action: sweep target centers at normalized (0.65,0.50), then (0.48,0.40). After: 2 discovered spots glow and the phase completes.
steps.next: The same exam booth arms CAST.

steps.title: Wrap the soft cast
steps.child_sees: The cast surface displays a starfish patient in a clamshell examination berth; the bandage roll rides the growing wrap edge.
steps.gesture: Draw gentle circles around the demonstrated pivot with one finger.
steps.configured_instruction: “Draw gentle circles to wrap the soft cast!” Key: op_doctor_cast_stage.
steps.embodied_action_and_contact: Source draws the roll at the wrap edge while cream strips grow across the lower-left arm/body. Roshan’s hand/roll/patient contact is unreviewed.
steps.before_action_after: Before: unwrapped arm. Action: qualifying circles accumulate 1.8 units. After: the cast strips reach their finished extent and the result holds.
steps.next: Approach the recovery bed for BANDAGE.

steps.title: Trace the stretchy bandage
steps.child_sees: The trace_doctor surface draws a teddy-shaped patient and a cream bandage roll. The exact rendered screen is missing.
steps.gesture: Start at the shown roll and swipe along the diagonal curved guide from upper-left toward lower-right.
steps.configured_instruction: “Swipe the stretchy bandage around the plushy!” Key: op_doctor_bandage_stage.
steps.embodied_action_and_contact: The trace is procedural and patient identity changes from CAST’s starfish to a teddy-shaped figure in source. Continuity and Roshan’s contact require native review.
steps.before_action_after: Before: an untraced corridor. Action: qualifying motion along the guide advances the visible bandage. After: a complete trace pays the 5-unit goal. A stationary tap cannot replace the swipe.
steps.next: Let the final care result and curtain call finish.

steps.title: See the healed-care result and cheer
steps.child_sees: The final phase result is held, then the shared curtain call restores Doctor Roshan and the surgeon imp, shows the goal prop and confetti.
steps.gesture: Finish the real bandage trace, then watch the result settle.
steps.configured_instruction: Configured win line: “Every stuffie is wiggling again — Roshan wins the surgeon relay!” plus the competition cheer. Voice key win is generic, not an auditioned exact transcript.
steps.embodied_action_and_contact: Roshan cheers and the rival bows. The complete action, patient result and actor/contact continuity have no captured finishing sequence.
steps.before_action_after: Before: incomplete bandage. Action: real final completion; 2.2-second phase result then 3.2-second act win display. After: completion callback becomes eligible.
steps.next: The completion callback awards and saves, then returns to the source room.

steps.title: Earn the star and return to the Playroom
steps.child_sees: The restored Stuffie Playroom card should show its completed pearl/marker; the reward HUD updates. No earned-return screenshot exists.
steps.gesture: Wait for the earned return; the Back button is the normal exit affordance.
steps.configured_instruction: No separate Doctor reward instruction is configured at this save seam.
steps.embodied_action_and_contact: The real act callback writes Doctor star bit 5, updates rewards and returns to the exact source room. It was not called or forged by the capture harness.
steps.before_action_after: First completion: opera_stars bit 5 plus 3 pearls; replay: the existing star remains and adds 1 pearl. The existing all-live-stars bonus can also apply on the final missing career. Save is written before return.
steps.next: Re-enter the Doctor picture to replay without losing the saved star.

steps.title: Replay with the saved star
steps.child_sees: The Doctor picture stays available outside the active Chapter 2 story roster, with its saved completion marker. Exact reload/replay screens are absent.
steps.gesture: Tap the same Doctor picture again after return or a genuine reload.
steps.configured_instruction: The five current phase instructions repeat on replay.
steps.embodied_action_and_contact: A new normal Doctor world starts at phase 0. This career has no enabled two-act mastery/checkpoint flow in current source; partial WASH persistence across app kill is not established.
steps.before_action_after: Before: saved Doctor star. Action: real reload/re-entry. After: retained star and a new WASH→FIND→X-RAY→CAST→BANDAGE run; this must still be captured and tested naturally.
steps.next: Finish another kind care session, or leave safely.

steps.title: Optional early exit
steps.child_sees: The top-left Back arrow returns to the same Stuffie Playroom. This exact return is captured after WASH and the FIND invitation.
steps.configured_instruction: No new task instruction is needed to leave; the room’s existing navigation returns.
steps.embodied_action_and_contact: The career controller cancels the still-playing act and restores the room. No remaining phases or completion callback are forced.
steps.before_action_after: Before: only WASH earned. Action: actual Back touch. After: playroom restored and opera_stars unchanged. This early-exit image is not an earned-completion/reward screenshot.
steps.next: Tap Doctor again when ready; saved partial-care resumption remains unverified.
